subject: Insurance
title: Insurance in 2050
description: A fast breakdown of Insurance in 2050 for builders.

buildup.text: Wearables track health, cars report driving, homes monitor hazards.

discovery.text: The industry may shift from reacting to losses to preventing them entirely.

twist.text: Total surveillance erases the boundary between insurer and life partner.

climax.text: The future of insurance is a bargain: maximum protection in exchange for maximum transparency.

punchline.text: Total protection, total surveillance. Privacy is the cost of future insurance.

quiz.question: What is the fundamental tradeoff in future real-time insurance models?
options: Maximum protection in exchange for maximum loss of privacy
